verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS support platform like Pylon, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented setting or control for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications and the Vanta-managed compliance are adjacent security posture, not an opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
